offline: The Amiga is not answering. Trying again…
disconnected: Lost the connection to Amigent. Trying again…
send_tip: Copy files from this PC to the Amiga
panel: Show or hide the keyboard panel
drop_here: Drop to send to the Amiga
mod_tip: Click: next key only. Double-click: lock.
kb_direct_tip: Key positions, held keys stay held
type_hint: The text goes to the active window, line breaks press Return.
restart_text: Open files are written to disk first. Unsaved work in programs is lost.
about_text: Your real Amiga, live on this PC, with mouse and keyboard.
thanks_text: tbdye for amigactld (GPLv3), Volker Barthelmann for vbcc
tip_paste: Ctrl+V types your PC's clipboard on the Amiga.
tip_keys: In full screen the Windows keys are the Amiga keys.
tip_paste_mac: Cmd+V types your Mac's clipboard on the Amiga.
tip_keys_mac: The Cmd keys are the Right Amiga key, for shortcuts such as Cmd+O.
find_hint: If the Amiga got a new address, Amigent finds it again by itself. Or enter it here:
tip_lock: Double-click a modifier to lock it, its LED gets long.
tip_drop: Drop files on the screen to send them.
rel_mouse_tip: Captures the mouse and sends its movement, for games. Esc releases it.
fleet_hint: Previews refresh every 20 seconds. Add Amigas with amigent-fleet --add NAME ADDRESS.
get_tip: Copy files from the Amiga to this PC
clip_get_tip: Copy the Amiga's clipboard to this PC
clip_put_tip: Put this PC's clipboard on the Amiga's clipboard
clip_got: Copied the Amiga's clipboard to this PC.
clip_put_done: On the Amiga's clipboard. Paste with Right Amiga+V.
